chunk.text: Astronauts are also given designated times for relaxation and self-care as part of their routine to help prevent burnout. Did you know? Astronauts witness 16 sunrises and sunsets per day aboard the space station, which can disrupt their sleep-wake cycle. Formal risk description: Risk of performance decrements and adverse health outcomes resulting from sleep loss, circadian desynchronization, and work overload
